shortDescription: Dungeons from Alexander Wales' "This Used to Be About Dungeons": levelled sites across the world map that generate a fresh chamber-graph pocket map per party, stocked with Titan Framework creatures and Entad Framework rewards.
body:
## Status
Build order: 1 World → 2 Entry → 3 Map generation → 4 Creatures → 5 Rewards → 6 Vehicle Framework.
Phases 1 and 2 done (summary commit 7ee5fcf). Phase 3 rewritten in builds 24-25 from the approved prototype `.circinus/mockups/dungeon-layout.html` (the build 22-23 attempt was discarded). Not yet tested in game.

## World (phase 1)
- `DungeonWorldComponent`: dungeons as plain data (surface tile id + level), saved as byte arrays, with `genVersion`, `generatedMaxLevel`. `enteredBy`: per tile, load ids of pawns who entered, cleared by Generate.
- Placement: seeded random order, BFS-blocked radius spacing-1. Land only unless Vehicle Framework + ocean setting.
- Levels: 3-octave Perlin over the unit sphere, ranked, level = 1 + floor(p^skew × max).
- `WorldDrawLayer_Dungeons`, bottom-right toggles, tile inspect line, world search, `Dialog_DungeonFinder`.

## Entry and leaving (phase 2)
- Enter via caravan gizmo, right-click on the tile, or forming a caravan toward it. `Dialog_EnterDungeon` splits the caravan; rules: one non-downed colonist, humanlikes ≤ cap, nobody who already entered (locked unticked with an "entered" marker). Everyone mode auto-ticks and locks when nobody able stays outside.
- Header: "Staying outside" and "Entering" rows built from vanilla `DrawCaravanInfo` / `DrawExtraInfo`.
- Party wealth = pawns + worn apparel + equipment. Effective level = level × (1 + wealth / wealthToDouble), stored on the site.
- `DungeonEntry.Enter` makes a `DungeonSite` (MapParent), generates the map, enters in front of the exit. `DungeonExit` (MapPortal) is a 3×1 stairway in the first chamber's north wall; `Dialog_LeaveDungeon` lists items to haul out. Map removed when no living player humanlike/mech remains; "party lost" letter.

## Map generation (phase 3)
`DungeonLayoutGenerator` (Source/DungeonLayout.cs) + `GenStep_DungeonLayout` + `DungeonThemeDef` (Source/DungeonThemeDef.cs, Defs/TUBAD_Themes.xml).
- Size: lerp(60, 150) by the dungeon's level over the world max. Layout seed rolled per party (`site.layoutSeed`); dressing (plants, remains) uses it too.
- **Chambers:** mostly natural caverns (wobbly blobs from angle sines + noise, rock pillars in big ones), 1 in 5 large, packed close. Built rooms are rare (theme builtChance × hilliness factor: flat 1.3 … mountainous 0.6) in shapes Rect, Hall (columns), Round, L, Cross; each has an exact locked 1-cell wall.
- **Tunnels:** A* over a noisy cost field, cheap through open space so tunnels reuse caverns; carved 1-3 wide. Spanning tree carves as it goes (a failed link falls to the next pair), plus loops between near neighbours. Two smoothing passes on natural rock; anything the exit cannot reach is filled in.
- **Dividers fit their surroundings:** doors (stone, tile rock) only in built-room walls; between two caverns a link may narrow to a 5-cell one-wide squeeze inside a locked ring, holding a 1-3 cell plug: rubble, ice plug, root tangle (flammable), sand drift. All plugs are Mineable. Links out of the entrance chamber never squeeze. Plugs do not seal everything: loops and overlapping caverns can go around them.
- **Exit:** built first chamber = stairway in its north wall; natural first chamber = 5-wide cut leading up to the stairway.
- Saved on the site (`DungeonLayoutData`): chambers (bounds, centre, radius, shape, skylight, depth, links), dividers (cells, def, door flag, chamber pair), exit cell. `site.theme` is for the visit only.

### Themes
- Picked per tile (seed = world seed + tile + layer), so every party at a dungeon sees the same theme. Rare themes (`rareChance`) are rolled first; then themes naming the biome; then numeric match on tile temperature, rainfall, swampiness and biome plantDensity, highest `priority` wins, ties by commonality. That is how modded biomes get a theme without patches.
- Shipped: Cave (default, 0), Overgrown (plantDensity ≥ 0.55, 1), Buried ruins (temp ≥ 8, rain ≤ 450, 2), Flooded (swampiness ≥ 0.4, 3), Frozen (temp ≤ -4, 4), Crypt (rare 8%, built 60%, halls and sarcophagi, tiled floors).
- **From the tile, not the theme:** primary rock (fixed per tile) colours the unbreakable walls (wall is madeFromStuff with that rock's blocks; not saveCompressible) and gives rough floor, flagstone/tile and chunks; the biome's own gravel/mud/shallow water fill theme patches; up to two of the biome's natural ground terrains as patches (biomeGroundShare); river or coast adds water to themes without it.
- **Vegetation:** glowing cave plants in noise patches (on a gravel bed when rock is too poor), kept 14 cells from the exit. Large caverns may have a collapsed ceiling (skylight): unroofed, the biome's fertile soil, and the biome's own wild plants at its plant density.
- **Clutter:** rock chunks of the tile rocks and rubble filth; dried corpses of the biome's wild animals (≤ 6, body size ≤ 2.5); built rooms get columns, sarcophagi (crypt) or debris.

Later: own-light vs dark dungeons, locked doors with keys/levers, more plug types (flooded squeezes), theme patches for popular biome mods.

## Settings (tabs)
- World: show icons, opacity, tint by level, spacing, max level, low level bias, roughness, ocean dungeons with VF.
- Parties: max party size 5, wealth that doubles the level 50,000.
- Planned: Creatures, Rewards.

## Agreed design (later phases)
- Phase 4 creatures via Titan: humanlikes, animals, insects, mechs if feasible; points from effective level; packs; tamable; suspended in undiscovered rooms. Toughness distribution is random, NOT tougher deeper in. Use chamber data for placement and dormancy only.
- Phase 5 rewards via EntadApi; binding single / party / unbound by settings.

## Textures
- World/TUBAD_Dungeon, World/TUBAD_Highlight, UI/TUBAD_ShowDungeons, UI/TUBAD_FindDungeons, Things/Building/TUBAD_DungeonExit, Things/Building/TUBAD_Rubble, TUBAD_IcePlug, TUBAD_RootTangle, TUBAD_SandDrift (placeholder SVGs).

## Mockups
- .circinus/mockups/dungeon-finder.html
- .circinus/mockups/dungeon-layout.html (layout prototype; the C# generator is a port of it)
